name: The Gathering
blurb: Norway's largest LAN party and demoscene festival, held over Easter in Hamar's Vikingskipet arena since 1996.
notes: The 2026 edition (TG26) ran April 1-5, 2026 at Vikingskipet, Hamar and has already concluded, so it is recorded as "last"; the homepage (re-rendered fresh 2026-10-05) still shows that edition's banner plus a 'Takk for i år!' (thanks for this year) message and no announced 2027 dates/venue, so no upcoming edition is recorded. LAN party / demoscene festival (coding, music, graphics, animation and gaming competitions), not a guest-driven convention — no celebrity guest program exists. Footer credits 'The Gathering 2026 - KANDU'; Kandu is the Norwegian non-profit that runs it. Cover uses the TG26-branded logo since the og/twitter image (tg23-oversikt.jpg) is a stale prior-year (TG23) photo and the other hero images are either small venue/crowd photos or a portrait crew photo.
